basic_info.description: A rare gem in San Francisco, this stand-alone two-level condo lives like a single-family home offering privacy, space, and style at a condo price. Tucked away at the rear of an exclusive two-structure property, this 2BR/2BA residence is flooded with natural light and designed for comfort and flexibility. The updated kitchen features sleek stainless steel appliances, modern finishes, and flows beautifully into living and dining areas, ideal for entertaining. There are multiple spots to set up the perfect space for working from home. Both bathrooms have been tastefully completed, and the well-proportioned bedrooms offer restful retreats. Step outside to your shared, beautifully maintained outdoor space, perfect for morning coffee, alfresco dining, or unwinding at the end of the day. One side by side parking spot adds even more convenience. Located in a vibrant, amenity-rich neighborhood with easy freeway access, this home offers the best of both worlds: the luxury of a single-family home with the ease and value of condo living. This is a truly special opportunity not to be missed.
